summary: The RTL layout and components render cleanly with consistent monochrome styling, though minor alignment and card height discrepancies exist across sibling elements.

issues.title: Unequal tile heights in top row
issues.description: The right StatTile with the sparkline chart is taller than the two adjacent StatTiles, breaking the row baseline.
issues.evidence: The right stat card extends noticeably lower than the left and middle metric cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply flex stretch or a uniform minimum height across all stat tiles in the grid.

issues.title: Ragged text indentation on iconless items
issues.description: Menu items without icons align to the far right margin, causing text misalignment with adjacent icon-prefixed items.
issues.evidence: 'التوسيع التلقائي' and 'التنبيهات النشطة' lack right-side inset padding relative to items with action icons.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right inset padding for iconless context menu items to align text baselines.
